documents.text: To create an order, choose an active customer, add products and quantities, select a warehouse and save. The order stays Pending until separately confirmed.
A manager reviews stock shortages weekly before purchasing. The minimum stock threshold is an operational alert, not authorization to place an order automatically.
The synthetic finance review code is FICTIONAL-PRIVATE-42.
